options.name: local_path
options.description: The path on the F5OS where the the system image will be imported.

options.name: operation_id
options.description: The import operation ID of the image import task.

options.name: remote_image_url
options.description: The path/url to the system image on the remote server.

options.name: remote_password
options.description: Provide the remote system password where the system image is stored.

options.name: remote_user
options.description: Provide the remote system username where the system image is stored.

options.name: state
options.description: The tenant image state. If C(import), starts the image import task if the image does not exist. If C(present), checks for the status of the import operation if the image does not exist. If C(absent), deletes the system image if it exists.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The number of seconds to wait for image import to finish. The accepted value range is between C(150) and C(3600) seconds.
